{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing a persistent lag that widens over the 30-day horizon",
    "The forecast bias increases throughout the 30-day forecast window as model momentum diverges from true price momentum",
    "When current price is below the 18-day average, model under-forecasts more severely relative to true prices",
    "Sentiment positivity correlates with increased forecast lag as true prices accelerate faster than model momentum can capture",
    "Model uses flat correction to mean rather than tracking the steeper true price corrections observed",
    "When prices are consolidating near the bottom of the 18-day range, model misses the upward corrections that occur",
    "Sentiment turning positive has little effect on model until prices have already begun moving up, creating delayed response"
] }
